name: MineSTM live-reserve LP redemption
summary: MineSTM converted incoming STM into a fraction of the bound STM/USDT pair's current LP supply using the pair's mutable live STM reserve, then removed that LP inventory for the caller. One bounded receipt changed the reserve before four redemptions; this review measures the exact MineSTM-plus-pair entity depletion and values STM from the sole pre-incident market state.

loss.notes: The victim entity is MineSTM 0xb7d0a1adafa3e9e8d8e244c20b6277bee17a09b6 plus its bound STM/USDT pair 0x2e45aef311706e12d48552d0daa8d9b8fb764b1c. Immediately before the receipt the pair holds 91,756.641426462709287653 USDT and MineSTM holds zero; afterward the pair holds 17.815912326718118003 and MineSTM remains zero, for exact entity depletion of 91,738.825514135991169650 USDT. The pair sends 591,738.825514135991169650 USDT while receiving 500,000 from the helper. It sends 2,314,287.608214378446697049 STM in the initial swap and 425,754.115294107803246467 through four LP burns, while MineSTM receives 851,508.230588215606492943 STM as redemption consideration. The resulting STM entity depletion is exactly 1,888,533.492920270643450573. Archive balances agree: combined STM falls from exactly 9,500,000 to 7,611,466.507079729356549427, and no unrelated same-block transaction touches either entity's STM or USDT. MineSTM holds 499,338.331500868972566582 of 499,338.331500868972567582 LP immediately before the receipt; the only other supply is the permanently locked 1,000 wei. Four burns consume 499,323.298010219937390466 LP and leave MineSTM 15.033490649035176116 LP, so no external LP inventory is charged. A complete pre-incident factory-log scan finds this as STM's only V2 pair and no V3 pool; standard BSC factories return no STM market. At block 39,381,373 the sole market has 91,756.641426462709287653 USDT / 2,740,054.541998103233948508 STM depth, implying exactly 0.033487158748143717276970686791644159494883811816510845881153 USDT per STM. The STM depletion is therefore $63,241.620878607452035423885641777403102812372209428855614566888502, and exact total loss is $154,980.446392743443205073885641777403102812372209428855614566888502. Binance-Peg 0x55d398326f99059ff775485246999027b3197955 reports name Tether USD, symbol USDT and 18 decimals and is valued at par. Pancake V3 pool 0x92b7807bf19b7dddf89b706143896d05228f3121 lends the helper exactly 500,000 USDT and receives 500,050, an exact 50-USDT financing fee external to the victim entity. The helper ends with zero USDT, sends 91,688.825514135991169650 USDT proceeds to the funds holder, and retains exactly the STM entity depletion. The funds-holder's later approval and disposal activity and the EOA's later native transfer are downstream exclusions; the bounded and later transfer scan finds no STM or USDT return or recovery to MineSTM or the pair.

ageReset.description: The direct MineSTM runtime and immutable STM, USDT, factory and router bindings existed at deployment, and STM authorized MineSTM before funding. This initLiquidity call is the last honest causal activation: it creates the bound pair and supplies 3,500,000 STM plus 350 USDT, thereby establishing the reserves and MineSTM-owned LP inventory that make sell functional. The mechanism verifies the pair's STM balance changing from zero to 3,500,000 STM. Later node-user mints add routine inventory but do not rebind or change the sell path, and no later token, pair, router, owner or causal configuration setter executes before the incident.

sources.note: Reviewed the complete exploit receipt and call trace; every STM, USDT and LP transfer; MineSTM, pair, helper, EOA, funds-holder and financing-pool archive balances and end states; same-block transaction flows; all pre-incident STM V2 PairCreated and V3 PoolCreated logs and factory getters; pair total supply and holders; token, target and pair creation/configuration receipts; the full MineSTM and STM administrative transaction histories through the incident; attacker-adjacent nonce and downstream return/recovery activity; verified target source; direct runtime continuity; and the commit-pinned reproduction. The anchor trace executes updateAllowance() and then sell(uint256) four times directly on MineSTM. Each sell transfers STM into MineSTM, reads the bound pair's current getReserves() and totalSupply(), computes amount * totalSupply / (2 * STM reserve), and sends that LP quantity through the standard router's removeLiquidity path. The code has no independent reserve bound, time-weighted reference or share-accounting constraint, so using a caller-mutable live reserve for protocol-owned LP redemption is the selected direct invariant failure; the token, standard pair/router and V3 pool provide inventory, market execution or financing. MineSTM is absent at block 39,363,734, is created top-level by 0x50e48af70271ab36b5f48fd7162d5851eb692849 in source-3, and has the identical 15,424-byte runtime hash 0x3aacbdce5d6b45b43d770767f6ad2815676b979b713618dd273282d0c7f7ddfb at deployment, activation and anchor minus one. It has zero EIP-1967 implementation and beacon slots and executes without target-originated DELEGATECALL in the anchor trace. The direct runtime's immutable bindings alone do not make sell functional: source-4 creates and funds the sole STM pair and mints its LP to MineSTM. The complete target and token administrative census finds no later change to those bindings or the implicated path. Code/configuration age is 1,717,694,757 - 1,717,682,179 = 12,578 seconds. EOA nonce 1 creates the helper and nonce 2 is the sole loss; nonce 3 and the funds-holder's later activity only activate and dispose of proceeds. Neither those receipts nor the later transfer scan return STM or USDT to the victim entity.
